site.title: Jacopo Bontà
site.description: Live portfolio of Jacopo Bontà — fullstack developer. Kept current automatically: repos, stars and public activity are pulled from GitHub and refreshed by the harness itself.

about: Most of my week goes into Cubbit, where I build the user-facing products — my favorite kind of work, because features people actually use are the ones worth getting right. When I build for myself, it's small tools that scratch a real itch. Right now AI agents are what I'm fascinated by: learning a lot, and building new tools with them. This page is generated from my public GitHub data and kept current automatically.

sugo.description: Go CLI (Cobra) that prepares human reviewers for GitHub PRs — fetches a PR, runs independent analysis agents in parallel, and produces a structured report. Never posts comments.

opencode-artifacts-plugin.description: Agent-generated plans and reports for opencode, reviewed in your browser: anchored inline comments, approve/request-changes, and a plan-first gate that blocks file edits until you sign off.

youtube-downloader.description: Python microservice that downloads YouTube videos (and converts them to MP3) behind a RESTful HTTP API, designed to run in a Docker container.

casual-platform.description: Casual game project written in TypeScript with the Phaser game development framework.
